findings.definition: canton open data dokument.csv answers joined to OPD by canton uid: attached / under an agenda item / parentless / absent

opd_response.summary: Root cause: the government's answer reaches OPD from two sources with the same document id; staging keeps the first parent seen and the government-agenda load runs first, so the answer hangs under that agenda item or has no parent if the item is not in OPD. Fix pending; the relink list is the interim workaround.

opd_response.summary: The document language is set per pipeline; an empty field means 'not specified'. Schema implication: document language allows 'unspecified', distinct from unknown.

findings.definition: body_key present in the docs exports, absent from affairs

opd_response.summary: Many communes publish only per-meeting documents (minutes) and no affairs. Deriving 'virtual affairs' from meeting documents is part of the challenge; OPD numbers them 'V' + start date (e.g. SO consultations).

findings.statement: Bodies with a docs export but zero affairs

opd_response.summary: 'V' + start date is OPD's virtual affair number (e.g. SO consultations), not a data error.

findings.definition: |year(begin_date) - year(number)| > 1; 2024-10-28 is a load timestamp; correction list results/repair/repair_BE_begin_date.tsv

opd_response.summary: 2024-10-28 is a load timestamp, not a date of the affair: older affairs (mostly 2010-2013) plus about 170 BE affairs from later loads. The true date is the affair's 'Eingereicht' event. Fix pending; correction list in results/repair/repair_BE_begin_date.tsv.

findings.statement: BE affairs whose begin_date is > 1 year off the year in their number
